mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties that additive when combined, increasing risk of anticholinergic adverse effects; tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which diphenhydramine may inhibit.
action: Monitor for excessive anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth, cognitive effects); consider alternative antihistamine with less anticholinergic activity or adjust tolterodine dosing if needed.
